studies.label: Main experiment: collaborative alternate uses with ChatGPT-4, followed by unaided immediate and three-week retention post-tests

counts_source.quote: The valid sample consisted of 52 dyads/104 participants, with 26 dyads/52 participants per experimental condition.

arms.name: Experimental AI group
arms.description: Self-formed dyads randomly assigned to off-the-shelf ChatGPT-4 in a chat window during the main AUT; free prompting, no researcher pre-prompting, and no copy-pasting into the answer box. AI was removed for both post-tests (PDF pp. 4-6, Sections 3 and 4.2).

arms.name: Control non-AI group
arms.description: Dyads randomly assigned to the same AUT and interface without AI; both post-tests were also unaided (PDF pp. 5-6, Sections 4.2.2-4.2.4).

studies.task: Computer Science students produced alternate uses for fork, flower pot, and suitcase as dyads, then for a glass bottle in an immediate unaided dyad post-test, and for key, brick, and gymnastics ball individually in an unaided online retention test three weeks later (PDF pp. 5-6, Section 4.2).

open_items: The initial randomized and excluded people/dyad counts are not printed. The analyzed valid sample and clusters_per_arm are supported by PDF p. 6, Section 4.3; the language-based inclusion rule is on PDF p. 5, Section 4.2.1.

The main and immediate elaboration U statistics are incompatible with an ordinary Mann-Whitney comparison at the stated dyad counts. Confirm the inferential rows, statistic convention, and treatment of dyad dependence, and obtain uncertainty at the randomized-dyad level (PDF pp. 7-9, Sections 4.5.1 and 5.1.1-5.1.2). No count is reconstructed from a test statistic or p-value. Second-round review confirms that s1_elaboration_main_ai_vs_control.se_basis and s1_elaboration_immediate_ai_vs_control.se_basis are unresolved schema exceptions: null is outside the allowed vocabulary, while not_reported is false because the tests and exact p-values are printed. No permitted replacement is established by the supplied source. Both nulls remain placeholders pending an explicit extraction-rule decision for reported uncertainty with an unconfirmed basis, or additional source evidence identifying the inferential observations and treatment of dyad dependence. The two reverify flags are valid and are not dismissed as false positives.

Immediate post-test fluency has narrative means and SDs, but the SD computational rows are not identified explicitly. The scored work was produced by dyads and the allowed sd_level vocabulary has no team category; sd_level remains null pending clarification (PDF pp. 7 and 9, Sections 4.5.1 and 5.1.2).

Retention analyzed counts and attrition are not confirmed. The procedure and Section 5.1.3 describe individuals, while Figure 12 labels dyads and Figure 1 depicts individuals. Confirm the number of analyzed people and aggregation before using this comparison (PDF pp. 5-6 and 9-10).

Except for immediate post-test fluency, arm means occur only in figures and are left null under extraction rule 1. Obtain text/table values and missing full-sample dispersion and uncertainty; subgroup statistics cannot replace these (PDF pp. 8-10, Section 5.1 and Figures 4-12).

Supplementary Materials are referenced but are not included in or embedded in the supplied PDF. No matching supplement was found under the paper identifiers in the local literature folder. The publisher landing-page request failed with a network socket permission error. Its scoring and statistical contents remain unverified (PDF pp. 5-7 and 10).

The paper preregisters flexibility/originality hypotheses but does not expressly designate primary outcomes.
